name: Navicular Stress Fracture of the Foot
tags: navicular stress fracture of the foot
definition: High-risk stress fracture of the tarsal navicular, typically causing dorsal midfoot pain in running and jumping athletes.

investigations.principle: Early radiographs may be normal; MRI detects stress reaction and CT defines fracture/healing.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when the condition-specific question requires soft-tissue, neural, marrow or occult-injury assessment.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs/CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: High-risk complete fractures may require prolonged immobilization or fixation.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Pada/Asthi overuse phenotype may be documented in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: High-risk stress fracture of the tarsal navicular, typically causing dorsal midfoot pain in running and jumping athletes.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for major trauma, acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe infection/systemic illness, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
